referenceSolutions.python:
def pressParenthesesPositiveProofStrip(readings, k):
    a=readings
    out=[]
    n=max(0,len(a)-1)
    dp=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for length in range(2,n+1):
        for left in range(n-length+1):
            right=left+length-1
            dp[left][right]=min(dp[left][m]+dp[m+1][right]+a[left]*a[m+1]*a[right+1] for m in range(left,right))
    out=[dp[0][r] for r in range(n)]
    return [x for x in out if x>0]
